_source: Shaped after the Claude on Vertex AI guide (https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/partner-models/claude/use-claude), whose rawPredict response is the Anthropic Messages response with a msg_vrtx_ id. The guide does not say how the response model relates to the id in the request path; the name-version spelling here is an assumption, accepted by the adapter with the other forms it lists. Usage fields are the Messages usage object (https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages). Not recorded from a live call.
